description: FREE lite accessibility lawsuit-risk scan of a website URL. Runs the same 20 checks as audit_a11y but returns top-line results only: 0-100 score, A-F grade, lawsuit-risk level, check counts, and the titles of the top gaps — no per-check evidence, no detailed recommendations. Use this to triage whether a site needs the full audit_a11y report, or call audit_a11y directly for the complete evidence-backed scan. Automated scan — not a compliance certification.

url.description: Website URL to scan, e.g. https://example-store.com

name: audit_a11y_lite
